name: Hilde Vautmans - Considérant I - Am 8
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: I. whereas both the EU and the People’s Republic of China officially support multilateralism and the central role of the UN; whereas constructive EU-China engagement, pursued in good faith by both sides, is essential to conflict prevention, peacebuilding, arms control and global crisis management, including a peace solution in Ukraine, and to regional dynamics in the Middle East, Africa and Asia;
